description: This file defines the SnapshotServer class responsible for serving snapshot data, screenshots, and resources in a web testing or tracing context. It includes methods for serving snapshots, closest screenshots, snapshot info, and resources, utilizing external snapshot storage and resource loader modules.

classes.name: SnapshotServer
classes.description: A class that manages serving snapshot data, screenshots, and resources over HTTP responses.

methods.name: serveSnapshot
methods.description: Serves an HTML snapshot page based on page or frame ID and search parameters.

methods.name: serveClosestScreenshot
methods.description: Serves the closest screenshot resource based on page/frame ID and search parameters.

methods.name: serveSnapshotInfo
methods.description: Provides JSON info about a specific snapshot.

methods.name: _snapshot
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot by name from storage.

methods.name: _respondWithJson
methods.description: Generates a JSON HTTP response from an object.

methods.name: serveResource
methods.description: Serves a resource (e.g., image, script) associated with a snapshot, handling content type and cache headers.
